The crash comes from R8 in release builds. It strips generic signatures, so `object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}` loses its type argument at runtime. I fixed this in `app/proguard-rules.pro`, which was previously empty apart from a comment. I could not build or run the app here, so this is unverified.

The new rules:
- **`-keepattributes Signature`** (plus annotations, `EnclosingMethod`, `InnerClasses`): keeps the generic metadata Gson reads from `TypeToken` subclasses. This is the direct fix for the error.
- **`-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken`** and related Gson rules: stop R8 from removing or renaming the `TypeToken` anonymous classes and Gson internals.
- **`-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.Book { *; }`**: Gson maps JSON to `Book` by field name, so R8 must not rename `id`, `title`, `author`, or `isbn`. Without this the release build would silently produce empty fields.

No Kotlin or Gradle code changed. The debug build was never affected, which matches what `DEV.md` says.
